evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.042 Torr at 99.4 sccm Ar immediately before growth.
Pressure continued rising monotonically through growth to 3.264 Torr despite unchanged temperature and flow setpoints.
Temperature 750.0 C and Ar 100.3 sccm match setpoints; oxygen remains low at 2.6 ppm, with no accompanying oxygen-rise signature of air ingress.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure range and an independent pressure/exhaust-conductance check to distinguish developing exhaust restriction from normal process evolution or gauge drift; sample characterization to determine growth outcome.
